description: Fork of exp670 (1.4569 @ 86.5M, nh=4 winner). Single change in out_proj: NAP 6 -> 8 (K=64 -> 256). KEEP tph=256 (NOT param-matched). Per-layer out_proj: 4*256*256*96 = 25,165,824 = 25.17M (4x larger). Total out_proj: 151M (+113M vs exp670). Total model: ~199.5M (+131%). LUT bandwidth out_proj 4x: 384 KB -> 1.50 MB per layer. Tests if 4x addressing precision AND 4x more tables pay off at nh=4. Row coverage at K=256, bs=16 = 32 visits/row/step (same as exp669 which failed at nh=6, NAP=8, tph=64), but here we have 4x more tables AND nh=4 anchor diversity. v_lut, qk_lut unchanged from exp670. Reference: exp670 = 1.4569 (target to beat); exp666 = 1.4544 @ 92.8M (current SOTA).
